text:
Iris: stop everything  we crossed 120M monthly requests. who signed us up for this rocket ship? :rocket:
Ben: wait seriously?? holy smokes. huge congrats team :tada:
Tao: celebration idea: rooftop skyline + boba truck + handheld sparklers (safely). vote with reactions: 1=boba, 2=sparklers, 3=virtual care boxes
Mina: boba truck pls. also a tiny poster that says "we serve the world" with a doodle of the mascot.
Sanjay: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/party-nyc-3o7qE1YN7aBOFPRw8k 
Iris: quick logistics q @OpsBot  any restrictions for food trucks at rooftop events?
OpsBot: Iris asked about rooftop food trucks. Automated: please consult OfficeOps. No prohibited items flagged; permit usually required for rooftops. OfficeOps tagging initiated.
Ben: sample ops order command for swag I used before:
```
/create-care-pack --items "boba-giftcard,sticker-pack,mini-sparkler" --qty 120 --ship-by 2026-07-02
```
Tao: can we do 2% of promo budget for treats? small spend, big smiles. @OpsBot tagging FinanceOps please.
Mina: remote folks matter: care boxes or local e-gift cards? what's easier for shipping globe-wide?
Sanjay: e-gift cards are fastest but less tactile. care boxes are nicer but shipping is a pain. opt-in survey?
Iris: timeline thought: party Friday 6pm PT, e-gift cards for APAC + care boxes for US/EU who opt in. will compile addresses via DM.
Ben: kudos thread: drop one-line shoutouts to people who kept things smooth this sprint.
Tao: big kudos to @Mina for the cache tuning. reduced cold-start latency big time.
Mina: thanks!! shoutout to @Tao for the graceful fallback logic that saved us during the spike.
Sanjay: extra props to infra on-call for the calm late-night reroute. y'all are heroes.
Iris: i'll collect kudos for the all-hands slide. also planning a 30s thank-you speech  does anyone want to co-host?
Ben: i'll co-host. promise to keep it under 60s and only one bad pun.
Mina: OpsBot: please confirm there are no conflicting events Friday evening and any building rules about pyrotechnics (sparklers).
OpsBot: Automated: Building policy flagged: open flames and pyrotechnics are not allowed indoors. Handheld sparklers outdoors may be permitted with prior approval from OfficeOps. No conflicting events detected Friday 17:00-20:00 PT.
Iris: noted. replace sparklers with LED glow sticks then. safer and still dramatic.
Tao: neon glow sticks it is. merch idea: limited-edition skyline enamel pin. who wants one?
Ben: me. will design a dumb little skyline with an espresso cup.
Sanjay: tagging FinanceOps again for allocation: rough estimate for 120 care boxes + pins + boba truck? ballpark ok.
OpsBot: Automated: FinanceOps notified for budget approval. Typical estimate: care boxes $18-$30 each, enamel pins $4-$9 each, boba truck rental depends on location/time.
Iris: perfect. will set up a short planning channel and send calendar invite once budget is confirmed. grateful for everyone who kept the systems humming this month. :heartpulse:
OpsBot: Automated: no critical incidents during traffic spike. Good job team!
